convert_numpy_features_to_lmdb: run the LMDBConversion module in convert mode to store numpy feature files into an LMDB database
extract_features_from_lmdb: run the LMDBConversion module in extract mode to write LMDB stored features back to numpy files
review_LMDBConversion_convert: review the LMDBConversion convert method that reads .npy feature files and writes them into an LMDB transaction
review_LMDBConversion_extract: review the LMDBConversion extract method that reads pickled items from LMDB and saves them as .npy files
test_LMDBConversion_execute: test the LMDBConversion execute method to verify it dispatches to convert or extract based on the mode argument
